notes.title: Block Bounce
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! 

We are happy to announce our title Block Bounce is now available on Steam!

In this arcade-inspired experience, you play as The Block, the last block of their kind. With each evil block launching at high velocity to remove you forever, you must use persistence and resilience to survive as long as you can!

Survive for 30 seconds and you’re a true block legend.

Customise your block with a colour picker and secret unlockables.

No upgrades. No power-ups. Just bounce-or-die.[/p][p]
This game has been created by a new company, Pinfall Games, made of ex Alarming Ladder and ex Solar Flare developers. Please check it out! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3670040/Block_Bounce/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217682/26e540ada1d1794dbcd0249fe0ee03a3802262c4.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Snotty's Sewer Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hello Sewer Dwellers!  💩

Snotty's Sewer has had an update! We have focused on adding some items and addressing issues voiced in reviews and online! 

New Additions:

[list]
[*] Items
We have added two more items to the game! The flare can be used to light the way with a red flame and can be dropped to light a darkened area of the sewer. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217682/0547572af2e83ab9ea49d6ac3159cb1346ec7d3e.png[/img]

The digital camera can be used to light the way with a camera flash in periods of time! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217682/9437a6e9882bc406a64e7c7b704e71162a600101.png[/img]

[*] Flashlight tracker! 
With our battery system you can now tell how charged your flashlight is by the colourful lights found on top of the flashlight. Green is good, yellow is find a battery soon, red is your flashlight will die soon and a flashing light means say your prayers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217682/99da9b9a19a2ac16a672e0a14645b0471e18a5a1.png[/img]

[*] Pause Menu
You can now pause the game when being chased!
[/list]

Balancing:

Apparently Snotty and his friends have been too mean to you all :( Here are a list of changes to help combat this:
[list]
[*] Shortcuts are now unlockable without a screwdriver 
[*] Snotty speed has been slightly decreased 
[*] 11 buttons in total now spawn (was 10) 
[*] Snotty can no longer T-1000 it's way though objects
[*] Some objects have been moved for better loops
[*] Flashlight has a more powerful beam of light
[*] Batteries last longer
[/list]
Bug Fixes:

Now... we made the game in a week and oh boy was it obvious 😅 We have made our best efforts to help with some bugs within the game!
[list]
[*] Screwdriver has been removed due to issues (however shortcuts are unlocked forever)
[*] Camera bob has been turned off due to uncapped FPS issues
[*] Fixed gaps within the map
[*] Fixed nav mesh issues
[/list]
Finally we would just like to thank you all for trying out Snotty's Sewer and leaving the feedback! We are still in shock from how well it is done and are definitely excited to explore more of Snotty in the future!

Many Thanks,
Alarming Ladder
